subtypes.name: Burgled
subtypes.setting:
- the player is at home
- the player is just a normal dude
- it's the year of 2026
- house is pretty messy and small
subtypes.hook:
- the player has an expensive anklet
- the burglar wants the anklet but didn't expect the player to be wearing it

cast.description: They want the player's expensive anklet but they didn't expect the player to be wearing it. They are also trying to prevent the player from calling the police.
If the player manages to call the police, they show up at the door and handcuff the burglar.

subtypes.goal:
- to protect the anklet
- to call the police

beats.title: Chilling at Home
beats.description: The player is at home on the sofa watching Modern Family

beats.title: Buglar Arrives
beats.description: The burglar sneaks in through the window and realises that the player is wearing the anklet

beats.title: The Fight
beats.description: The burglar and the player begin to fight, punching, kicking and tackling each other to the ground all while the player is trying to get to the phone to call the the police

beats.title: Calling Police
beats.description: The player manages to reach the phone

beats.title: Police Arrive
beats.description: A bunch of police men arrive and handcuff the burglar

subtypes.choiceFlavour: Weather to hide, fight or run, what object to pick up and use, which way to get to the phone on the other side of the room

subtypes.name: Ahoy, Captave!
subtypes.setting:
- the player is being held captive on a pirate ship
- they are at sea
- it is the year 1900
subtypes.hook: - the player knows where a treasure chest is

cast.description: They want the player to tell them where the treasure chest is

subtypes.goal:
- the player is trying to escape somehow
- the player is trying not to give away where the treasure chest is

beats.title: Wakes Up
beats.description: The player wakes up in the pirate ship in the middle of the ocean, surrounded by angry looking pirates

beats.title: Explanation
beats.description: The captain explains that if the player tells him where the treasure chest is, he will set them free

beats.title: Idea
beats.description: The player notices some flares at the other end of the ship

beats.title: Fight
beats.description: The player has to fight and defeat each one of the pirates to get to the flares

beats.title: Rescue
beats.description: The player fires the flares and about an hour later, a rescue boat arrives

subtypes.choiceFlavour: What objects to fight with, what to say to the pirates, which order to fight the pirates

subtypes.name: All in a Day's Work
subtypes.setting:
- the player is a member of the police
- it is the year 2026
- the story starts in an office, then in an art gallery
subtypes.hook:
- the player is a member of the police 
- somebody is stealing the Mona Lisa from an art gallery

cast.description: The thief wants the Mona Lisa
They own the gallery and are paying the player to get the Mona Lisa back

subtypes.goal:
- catch the criminal
- arrest the criminal
- return the Mona Lisa

beats.title: Call
beats.description: The player is in their office with a donut and a mug of coffee when they get a call from the gallery owner

beats.title: Hunt
beats.description: The player arrives and hunts down the thief

beats.title: Fight
beats.description: The player and the thief begin to fight

beats.title: Handcuffed
beats.description: The player handcuffs the thief and returns the Mona Lisa

subtypes.choiceFlavour: Weather to sneak up on the thief or not, weather to just satay in the office eating their donut

subtypes.name: Jungle
subtypes.setting: Dense jungle, vines, humid air, distant howls, half-buried ruins of a forgotten civilisation.
subtypes.hook: The player has a torn map fragment showing a temple at the jungle's heart — something valuable is hidden there.

cast.description: Knows the jungle better than anyone. Hiding something about why they agreed to help.
Charming and ruthless. Wants the artefact for themselves.
A villager who insists the player turn back.

subtypes.goal: Reach the inner chamber of the temple and decide what to do with what's inside.

beats.title: Arrival
beats.description: Meet the guide at the jungle's edge. Hear the warning from a local.

beats.title: Obstacle
beats.description: Cross a chasm, solve a ruin puzzle, or face a wild animal.

beats.title: Rivalry
beats.description: Encounter the rival. Choice point: cooperate, deceive, or confront.

beats.title: Discovery
beats.description: Reach the chamber. A twist about what the artefact really is.

subtypes.tone: Pulpy adventure-serial. Indiana Jones energy. Exclamations, dramatic descriptions, sweat and danger.
subtypes.choiceFlavour: Trust vs suspicion of allies. Brave vs cautious in danger. Keep vs return the artefact.
